verdict.rationale: Blink is a client-side iOS terminal app, not a hosted service. The closest thing to self-hosting here is that its open-source GitHub repo lets you download, build and install Blink yourself on your own iOS devices through Xcode, without relying on the App Store build. Community comments confirm the open-source development process. Missing for 10: detailed build/deployment documentation, an explicit open-source license, independent hands-on reports of self-built installs, and any self-hostable server-side component (it only connects to your own VS Code server rather than hosting one).
